verdicts.ar: حميدا لم ير عمر ولم يسمع منه شيئا، وسنه وموته يدل على ذلك، ولعله قد سمع من عثمان لأنه كان خاله، وكان ثقة كثير الحديث، توفي سنة خمس وتسعين وهو ابن ثلاث وسبعين سنة
verdicts.en: Humayd did not see Umar nor hear anything from him; his age and the date of his death show it. Perhaps he heard from Uthman, since Uthman was his maternal uncle. He was reliable and had many hadith. He died in 95 AH at seventy-three.

bio: A Madinan Successor of Banu Zuhra, son of the Companion Abd al-Rahman ibn Awf and, through his mother Umm Kulthum bint Uqba, nephew of the caliph Uthman. He heard Mu'awiya deliver this hadith from the pulpit and passed it to his younger clansman al-Zuhri. The rijal works record three different kunyas for him, which Ibn Hajar counts among the things that catch a careful reader's eye. Al-Waqidi's note that he was too young to have heard Umar is the standard example of dating being used to test a chain.
